{"scratch": "Morning (05:00-08:00) counter_k1: Holds phones, mugs, notebooks, chargers, lunchboxes, shared items (dog_leash, water_bottles). 05:36: phones/mugs/notebooks/chargers present; lunchboxes/bottles/pan absent. 06:17: durable items only; phones absent. By 09:00+: phone_marisol leaves (p<0.15); phone_nico persists. Mugs drop to <0.10 by 10:00. Pens/pots appear by 10:00. Resident presence dictates location: if resident_1 at counter, raise prob for their items (charger, notebook, mug) to 0.80-0.90. If resident in bedroom, raise prob for personal items in bed/nightstand to 0.60-0.75 only if resting.

Daytime (10:00+) counter_k1: If resident_2 at counter, lower phone_marisol to 0.10; keep phone_nico 0.90. Mugs/notebook/lunchbox/charger persist. Confirmed: phones/charger/notebook/lunchbox 0.90, mug_marisol 0.85, mug_talia 0.10, keys_nico 0.05.

Cupboard_k1: For 10:00+, if resident_2 at cupboard, lower keys_nico to 0.10; keep other keys <0.05. Cupboard is not a key storage spot for Nico in this context.

Sink_k1: Primary storage for shared cookware. For 10:00+, if resident_2 at sink, raise prob for shared pans/pots/plates to 0.80-0.90; lower ON_PERSON to <0.10. Morning (05:00-08:00), if sink empty of people, raise pan/pot to 0.90, lower plate to 0.30. Shared cookware persists in sink even when unoccupied.

d07 Mon 05:58/06:11: cupboard_k1: keys_nico, plate_shared_1 present; no residents. Contradicts prior belief that cupboard is not a key spot for Nico (prob 0.10). Update: keys_nico in cupboard_k1 is plausible (0.40-0.60) even without resident presence. plate_shared_1 also found here, suggesting cupboard holds shared dishes/keys, not just cookware. Adjust forecasts for cupboard_k1 to include keys_nico and plate_shared_1 with higher confidence.

d07 Mon 06:17: desk_b3: lunchbox_nico present; no residents. Confirms desk_b3 as a storage spot for Nico's lunchbox (prob 0.80). Absence of phone_nico/charger_nico/keys_nico validated (p<0.10). No belief change; scratch memory updated to reflect desk_b3 as a valid location for lunchbox_nico.

d07 Mon 06:17: counter_k1: charger_marisol, dog_leash_shared_1, lunchbox_talia, mug_marisol, phone_marisol, phone_nico, phone_talia, water_bottle_marisol; resident_3. My forecast missed dog_leash, lunchbox_talia, water_bottle_marisol (p~0) and overestimated charger_nico (0.75 vs 0). Counter holds shared items and Talia's lunchbox, not just Marisol/Nico tech.

d07 Mon 06:17: bedroom_floor_b3 empty; no residents. Confirms Nico's items (lunchbox, phone, keys, charger, backpack, jacket, water_bottle, headphones) are not on the floor (p<0.05). Validates that Nico's gear is stored in specific receptacles (desk_b3, counter_k1) or on person, not loose on floor. No belief change; scratch memory updated to reflect floor as low-probability spot for Nico's personal items.

d07 Mon 06:39: nightstand_b1: book_marisol, glasses_marisol; resident_1. Confirms Marisol's bedside items (book, glasses) persist here (p>0.80). Absence of phone/charger/meds/wallet/keys validated (p<0.10). Nightstand is for reading/eye-care, not tech or meds. No belief change; scratch memory updated to reflect nightstand_b1 as a stable spot for book_marisol and glasses_marisol.

d08 Tue 06:30: desk_b3: empty; resident_3 present. Contradicts d07 06:17 (lunchbox_nico here). Nico's items are transient on desk_b3, not stable storage. Lower lunchbox_nico prob to 0.20 for morning; expect items to move to counter_k1 or ON_PERSON by 07:00. Desk is a temporary drop zone, not a repository.

d08 Tue 06:30: bedroom_floor_b3: hairbrush_marisol, headphones_nico; resident_3. Nico's headphones are on the floor, not desk/counter. Marisol's hairbrush is here, not nightstand. Floor is a valid transient spot for personal items when resident is present. Update: raise prob for headphones_nico on floor to 0.60 if resident_3 present; hairbrush_marisol 0.40.

d08 Tue 06:30: bed_b3 empty; resident_3 present. Confirms Nico's gear (lunchbox, phone, charger, keys, water_bottle, backpack, jacket, headphones) is not on the bed (p<0.05). Validates that Nico's items are transient on desk_b3/floor_b3 or ON_PERSON, not stored in bed. No belief change; scratch memory updated to reflect bed_b3 as a low-probability spot for Nico's personal items."}
